title.zh: 中央公积金（指明雇佣）条例 1966

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Central Provident Fund (Specified Employment) Regulations 1966.

2. Where an employee is engaged in an employment specified in the first column of the Schedule, the person specified as the principal employer in the second column of the Schedule is deemed to be the employee’s employer for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Employment
Principal employer
As master, seaman or apprentice in any vessel whose owners do not have a place of business in Singapore.
Any person who is the attorney or agent in Singapore for the owners of the vessel.
